# 1) Core circuit solver (CircuitModel.cs)
Simple nodal solver for small DC circuits using KCL for nodes and linear solve (Gaussian elimination). Works for up to dozens of nodes — more than enough for prototypes.
```csharp
// Assets/HVAC_Moba/Scripts/Circuit/CircuitModel.cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
namespace HVAC_Moba.Circuit {
public class CircuitModel {
// Node indexed by int id (0..N-1)
public int NodeCount => nodes.Count;
private List<Node> nodes = new List<Node>();
private List<ComponentBase> components = new List<ComponentBase>();
public int CreateNode() {
nodes.Add(new Node(nodes.Count));
return nodes.Count - 1;
}
public void AddComponent(ComponentBase comp) {
components.Add(comp);
}
// Solve DC circuit: returns node voltages relative to global reference (node 0 is ground)
// Uses simple linear system: G * V = I
public double[] SolveDC() {
int n = NodeCount;
if (n == 0) return new double[0];
// Build conductance matrix and current vector
double[,] G = new double[n, n];
double[] I = new double[n];
// populate
foreach (var c in components) {
c.ContributeToSystem(G, I, n);
}
// enforce node 0 = 0 (ground)
// replace row 0 with identity for stability
for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) { G[0, j] = 0; }
for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) I[j] = I[j]; // unchanged
G[0, 0] = 1.0;
I[0] = 0.0;
// Solve linear system G * V = I using Gaussian elimination
return SolveLinearSystem(G, I);
}
private double[] SolveLinearSystem(double[,] A, double[] b) {
int n = b.Length;
double[,] a = new double[n, n+1];
for (int i=0;i<n;i++) {
for (int j=0;j<n;j++) a[i,j] = A[i,j];
a[i,n] = b[i];
}
// forward elimination
for (int i=0;i<n;i++) {
// pivot
int pivot = i;
for (int r=i+1;r<n;r++) if (Math.Abs(a[r,i]) > Math.Abs(a[pivot,i])) pivot = r;
if (Math.Abs(a[pivot,i]) < 1e-12) continue;
if (pivot != i) for (int c=0;c<=n;c++){ var tmp=a[i,c]; a[i,c]=a[pivot,c]; a[pivot,c]=tmp; }
// normalize row
double div = a[i,i];
for (int c=i;c<=n;c++) a[i,c] /= div;
// eliminate below
for (int r=i+1;r<n;r++) {
double f = a[r,i];
if (Math.Abs(f) < 1e-15) continue;
for (int c=i;c<=n;c++) a[r,c] -= f * a[i,c];
}
}
// back substitution
double[] x = new double[n];
for (int i=n-1;i>=0;i--) {
double val = a[i,n];
for (int j=i+1;j<n;j++) val -= a[i,j] * x[j];
x[i] = (Math.Abs(a[i,i]) < 1e-12) ? 0.0 : val / a[i,i];
}
return x;
}
// public helper to compute node voltages repeatedly
}
public class Node {
public int Id;
public Node(int id) { Id = id; }
}
}
```

```csharp
// Assets/HVAC_Moba/Scripts/Circuit/Battery.cs
using System;
namespace HVAC_Moba.Circuit {
public class Battery : ComponentBase {
public double Voltage;
public double InternalResistance;
public Battery(string name, int a, int b, double voltage, double rInternal=0.01) : base(name,a,b) {
Voltage = voltage;
InternalResistance = rInternal;
}
public override void ContributeToSystem(double[,] G, double[] I, int nodeCount) {
// model as resistor between A and B with a current source effect
double g = 1.0 / Math.Max(InternalResistance, 1e-12);
// stamp resistor between a,b
if (NodeA>=0) G[NodeA,NodeA] += g;
if (NodeB>=0) G[NodeB,NodeB] += g;
if (NodeA>=0 && NodeB>=0) { G[NodeA,NodeB] -= g; G[NodeB,NodeA] -= g; }
// inject currents to represent voltage: I = g * V across terminals into nodes
// equivalent: we set I[node] += g * V for NodeA and I[NodeB] -= g * V
if (NodeA >= 0) I[NodeA] += g * Voltage;
if (NodeB >= 0) I[NodeB] -= g * Voltage;
}
}
}
```

```csharp
IEnumerator LoadScenario(string resourcePath) {
TextAsset ta = Resources.Load<TextAsset>(resourcePath);
if (ta == null) { Debug.LogError("Scenario not found: " + resourcePath); yield break; }
var json = ta.text;
var doc = JsonUtility.FromJson<ScenarioDoc>(json);
BuildCircuitFromDoc(doc);
statusText.text = "Scenario loaded: " + doc.name;
yield return new WaitForSeconds((float)doc.faults[0].activateAfterSeconds);
// activate fault
circuit.AddComponent(new Short("short1", doc.faults[0].a, doc.faults[0].b));
statusText.text = "Fault: short injected between nodes " + doc.faults[0].a + " and " + doc.faults[0].b;
}
void BuildCircuitFromDoc(ScenarioDoc doc) {
circuit = new CircuitModel();
for (int i=0;i<doc.nodes;i++) circuit.CreateNode();
foreach (var c in doc.components) {
if (c.type == "Battery") circuit.AddComponent(new Battery(c.name, c.a, c.b, c.voltage));
else if (c.type == "Resistor") circuit.AddComponent(new Resistor(c.name, c.a, c.b, c.resistance));
else if (c.type == "Switch") circuit.AddComponent(new Switch(c.name, c.a, c.b, c.closed));
}
// attach to meter
meter.circuit = circuit;
}
```

## Step 1 — Create a logger library (one time)
At `>`:
```
edit logger.lua
```
Paste this:
```lua
-- logger.lua  (Logos-grounded logging)
-- Writes append-only logs + simple invariant reporting.
local M = {}
M.path = "/agent.log"
local function ts()
-- human-readable timestamp (not wall clock, but world clock)
return string.format("t=%d dt=%0.2f", os.time(), os.clock())
end
local function append(line)
local h = fs.open(M.path, "a")
h.writeLine(line)
h.close()
end
function M.log(kind, msg)
append(string.format("[%s] %-8s %s", ts(), kind, msg))
end
function M.invariant(name, ok, detail)
if ok then return true end
M.log("INVAR", name .. " :: " .. (detail or ""))
return false
end
function M.wrap(mainFn)
return function(...)
M.log("START", "agent boot")
local ok, err = pcall(mainFn, ...)
if not ok then
M.log("CRASH", tostring(err))
-- show crash on screen too
print("CRASH:", err)
end
M.log("STOP", "agent halted")
end
end
return M
```
Save: **Ctrl+S**, exit: **Ctrl+E**

## Step 2 — Create a “tail” program so you can copy-paste logs easily
At `>`:
```
edit tail.lua
```
Paste:
```lua
-- tail.lua: prints last N lines of /agent.log
local path = "/agent.log"
local n = tonumber(({...})[1]) or 40
if not fs.exists(path) then
print("No log file:", path)
return
end
local lines = {}
local h = fs.open(path, "r")
while true do
local line = h.readLine()
if not line then break end
lines[#lines+1] = line
end
h.close()
local start = math.max(1, #lines - n + 1)
for i = start, #lines do
print(lines[i])
end
```
Save/exit.
Now you can do:


```lua
local log = require("logger")
local function main()
log.log("INFO", "Agent present.")
-- Minimal ontology (we keep it tiny on purpose)
local state = {
mode = "IDLE",
ticks = 0,
}
while true do
state.ticks = state.ticks + 1
-- Invariants (examples; we’ll expand later)
log.invariant("MODE_VALID",
state.mode == "IDLE" or state.mode == "OBSERVE" or state.mode == "WORK",
"mode=" .. tostring(state.mode)
)
-- Heartbeat: proves persistence
if state.ticks % 5 == 0 then
log.log("HEART", "mode=" .. state.mode .. " ticks=" .. state.ticks)
print("OK", "mode=" .. state.mode, "ticks=" .. state.ticks)
end
os.sleep(1)
end
end
log.wrap(main)()
```
